quote: For text quality, we divide it into 3 subaspects: 1) Topic Relevance, measured by input salient word coverage ratio, and sentence- or corpus-level BLEU ; 2) Diversity, measured by distinct unigrams and bigrams ; 3) Fluency, measured by the perplexity computed using Huggingface's pretrained GPT-2. We also compute the ratio of cropped sentences among all sentences to assess how well they fit music phrase segments. For music alignment, we compute the percentage where the stress-duration rule holds.

Turker Qualification We used qualification tasks to recruit 120 qualified annotators who 1) have enough knowledge in song and lyric annotation, and 2) pay sufficient attention on the Mechanical Turk platform.

We used qualification tasks to recruit 120 qualified annotators... Each piece of music was annotated by at least three workers, who were asked to evaluate the quality of the lyrics using a 1‑5 Likert scale on six dimensions across musicality and text quality.
We used qualification tasks to recruit 120 qualified annotators who 1) have enough knowledge in song and lyric annotation, and 2) pay sufficient attention on the Mechanical Turk platform.
guideline: For musicality, we asked them to rate singability (whether the melody's rhythm aligned well with the lyric's rhythm) and intelligibility (whether the lyric content was easy to understand when listened to without looking at the lyrics). For the lyric quality, we asked them to rate coherence, creativeness, and in rhyme. Finally, we asked annotators to rate how much they liked the song overall.
Annotators rated the generated lyrics on six criteria (singability, intelligibility, coherence, creativeness, rhyme, overall quality) using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
